scenes.basis: 11:6 "he stayed two days in the place where he was" - "where he was" is beyond the Jordan (10:40); 11:7 "Let's go into Judea again"
11:1 "a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany"; 11:18 "Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away"
11:47 "The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council" - in the city
11:54 "to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples"
